title: Host slot markers measured FROM the element you wrap collapse to 0x0 — cache the marker element, not its geometry
trigger: Wrapping a host element whose in-flow space is reserved by a placeholder that the host sizes FROM that element — after the wrap the marker stays 0x0 forever, so geometry probes (elementsFromPoint, rect containment) can never find it again
principle: A slot marker's VALUE is its DOM position, not its current size. When the host derives the marker's box from the element being wrapped, the marker collapses permanently once wrapped — remember the marker element (WeakMap shell→marker) on first discovery and reuse it while connected; keep the last measured size separately.

cases.context: m.youtube .player-placeholder reserves the player's in-flow slot and is sized by YouTube JS from #player-container-id. Split-view wraps the shell into a stage; the placeholder stays 0x0, hit-test + doc-space probes both reject it, and the wrapper falls back to the shell's body-level DOM spot — video pulled above the masthead.
cases.bad: if (rect.width < 1) return null; const hits = elementsFromPoint(...); for (const el of hits) if (sameSize(el)) return el; return null;
cases.good: const cached = keepers.get(shell); if (cached?.isConnected) return cached; // probe as before; keepers.set(shell, found)

applyFor: wrapping any out-of-flow host element with a reserved in-flow slot
probing DOM by geometry where hosts zero out markers
